findings.title: Removing per-request Init calls drops the "service is stopping" rejection
findings.body: `Stop` sets `s.initErr = "service is stopping"`. Every handler used to call `s.Init(ctx)`, which returned that error, so requests made after shutdown began were refused. Init now runs only in the constructor, and the per-request calls are gone from Create, Update, Delete, Read, List, Watch and the other handlers. After `Stop`, these handlers keep serving and writing against a backend and search index that are shutting down. Keep a cheap check in the handlers, for example returning `s.initErr` if it is set. Alternatively, add a separate stopping flag and check that.

findings.title: Integration test skipped entirely for postgres
findings.body: The test is now skipped for postgres, so this change loses its only integration coverage on that database. The PR summary calls this "enhanced PostgreSQL test compatibility", which hides the skip. Fix the underlying failure, or track the skip in an issue, instead of disabling the test.
